Vault constrains resource permissions and credential duration, denying and revoking unauthorized activity.
The Brief proposes a reusable human review of task, systems, lifetime and revocation with retained evidence.

allowed_causal_edges.condition: Only when attempted action exceeds approved scope; no unconditional denial implied

excluded_claims: No person icon, shield badge, automatic universal safety, infinite credential, guaranteed enforcement result or vendor certification of the editorial procedure.
